payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-09-28 (PR #3142): PARTLY DONE - docs/clinical-hazard-analysis.md now carries a proposed Hazard H8 (services crisis helpline routing: H8a a crisis query fails to pin or route the right crisis line; H8b a non-crisis record carries a crisis chip) with its controls, tests and gaps, and ranks H8a and H8b in the risk register. STILL OPEN: H8 is marked proposed and not clinically reviewed, and it is not yet in docs/clinical-hazard-controls.json, so data/hazard-register-snapshot.json and the developer-hub view still list only the registered hazards. NEXT: owner reviews H8, adds the H8 control entry to docs/clinical-hazard-controls.json, and refreshes the hazard snapshot per the register's own procedure.
